tests: locked (lockTests setting)
test globs: **/*.test.*, **/*.spec.*, **/test_*.py, **/*_test.py, **/*_test.go, **/tests/**, **/__tests__/**, **/spec/**
gate: on, up to 3 rounds, timeout 5m 00s

files changed since the last check: no
last run: 2025-10-09T08:53:20.040Z (just now), exit 0, 0.0s, passed

commands.name: unlock-tests
commands.description: Let Claude edit existing test files for the rest of this session
commands.output: done-gate: tests are unlocked for this session. /lock-tests locks them again.

commands.name: lock-tests
commands.description: Lock existing test files again for this session
commands.output: done-gate: tests are locked for this session.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
/unlock-tests → done-gate: tests are unlocked for this session. /lock-tests locks them again.
/lock-tests → done-gate: tests are locked for this session.

notes: types ./types/index.d.ts declares on $: nothing (no EngineInterface member)
types ./types/index.d.ts declares state: done-gate.lockOverride, done-gate.created, done-gate.hasChanges, done-gate.rounds, done-gate.lastRun, done-gate.hasSaidNoCommand
./register.ts hooks: session.start, tool.call, classic.Stop, command.run{command=done-gate}, command.run{command=unlock-tests}, command.run{command=lock-tests}

./register.ts calls: $.clock.now (via report, runCheck), $.command.register (via registerCommands), $.fs.exists (via existsOrUnknown, probeProject), $.fs.read (via probeProject), $.process.run (via runCheck), $.session.root (via gate, guard, noteChange, report), $.state.get, $.state.set, $.ui.toast (via gate)
./register.ts state writes: done-gate.created, done-gate.hasChanges, done-gate.hasSaidNoCommand, done-gate.lastRun, done-gate.lockOverride, done-gate.rounds
./register.ts state reads: done-gate.created, done-gate.hasChanges, done-gate.hasSaidNoCommand, done-gate.lastRun, done-gate.lockOverride, done-gate.rounds
